programme.title: Hostel
programme.desc: The story is about a girls' hostel where girls from different cities come to get an education. programme.title: Ishq Ek Gunah
programme.desc: Kareem, a successful businessman, lives a blissful life with his beautiful wife and grown-up children. But fate has a way of turning happiness into turmoil in a single moment. One tragic day, Kareem’s loyal driver sacrifices his life in a fatal accident while saving Kareem. Shaken and indebted, Kareem takes it upon himself to honor this ultimate sacrifice. He brings the driver’s grieving wife, Fatima, and their young daughter, Nasreen, into his own home. Nasreen, a strikingly beautiful yet ambitious young woman, is quickly captivated and consumed by the wealth and grandeur of Kareem’s household. Envy takes root, and she begins to plot her way into Kareem’s heart, weaving schemes to replace the harmony of his family with her own desires.

programme.title: Rishtey Series
programme.desc: The theme of our special stories series is Relationships. Relationships without which our life is incomplete. Relationships are the asset of our life that binds us together in the rope of feelings and emotions. Relationships are the blessings of God that we do not choose by ourselves. Throughout our life, there are many colors of relationships like love, hate, friendship, feeling, trust, and every color of relationships is special. And you will see all these special colors in the series 'Rishtay' on AAN TV.

programme.title: Mera Susraal
programme.desc: It is a story of Dua who marries Nadeem Ahmed out of love and enters a household where her sisters-in-law, elder and younger, engulf their lives in the greed for wealth, poisoning the happiness of Nadeem Ahmed and Dua's joy-filled life. The elder and younger sisters always assert their dominance over Nadeem Ahmed, and he, in turn, obeys their every command. In reality, both these sisters never wanted Nadeem Ahmed to marry Dua, but Nadeem Ahmed fell in love with Dua, and they got married, dreaming of starting a new life together, which remained incomplete due to the selfishness of the sisters.

programme.title: Muqaam
programme.desc: Amber and Sehar are very close friends. Amber is a simple, homely girl, while Sehar is modern, bold, and a little selfish, driven by her love for wealth. Amber gets married to Hassan, a handsome young man who believes that an ideal life partner should be modern and bold. Although Hassan marries Amber due to his family's choice, when he meets Sehar, he sees his ideal partner in her. Hassan's admiration and constant praise for Sehar greatly please her, and she completely forgets that she is crossing boundaries with her best friend's husband. Amber's simplicity and naïve nature create the space for Hassan and Sehar to grow closer, until Hassan even decides to marry Sehar as his second wife. Will Amber and Sehar's friendship turn into hatred? By rejecting Amber's love, will Hassan openly confess his love for Sehar? When respect disappears from relationships, how can anyone find their true place?

programme.title: The Abyss
programme.desc: Ed Harris and Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio are formerly married petroleum engineers who still have some issues to work out. They are drafted to assist a gung-ho Navy SEAL with a top-secret recovery operation: a nuclear sub has been ambushed and sunk, under mysterious circumstances, in some of the deepest waters on Earth.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

programme.title: Planet Earth: Kingdom
programme.desc: Injured wild dog Flint helps care for Storm's largest ever litter of pups. Leopard Mutima searches far and wide for a home, and the lions are challenged by forces beyond their control.

programme.title: Planet Earth: Kingdom

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

programme.title: A League of Their Own
programme.desc: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey (Garry Marshall). Madonna and Rosie O'Donnell co-star as two of the sisters' teammates.

programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: The creators of the production invite viewers on a journey through the lush world of plants.It hides many surprising phenomena and hundreds of amazing heroes.Thanks to the lenses of specialized cameras, the mysterious life of nature's creations will be shown up close.Scientific research shows that nature is a perfect system of connecting vessels.In each of the five episodes, we will learn about a different group of plants and the secrets of their survival.The creators will talk about, among others:stories about seeds that can survive civilizations, trees that take care of each other, and creatures of nature that are as aggressive and spontaneous as animals.We will also learn about the relationships between people and animals with plants.It turns out that plants count, hunt, cheat, communicate, protect their relatives and manipulate animals for their own purposes.Contrary to appearances, when plants and animals interact with each other, it is usually the plant that sets the tone of the relationship.The series' narrator will be Sir David Attenborough, a popularizer of natural science.

programme.title: Dynasties
programme.desc: Chimpanzees are an endangered species.These animals live in complex social structures.Pack leaders can control them through various conflict and cooperation strategies.The power in the group is exercised by the alpha male, who rules by winning fights with his competitors.David, the leader of a tribe of chimpanzees living in the forests of Senegal, retains his title for the third year in a row.His herd is struggling, among other things, with the effects of long-term drought and deforestation caused by the gold rush, and David is surrounded by rivals, younger chimpanzees who want to overthrow him.They are ready to kill for this purpose.To stay in power, the dominant animal uses political arrangements.

programme.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programme.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's Spice Trail Adventure
programme.desc: Actress Joanna Lumley, known from the films "Absolutely Fabulous" and "The Wolf of Wall Street", goes on an expedition to discover the origins of spices.It follows two continents in the footsteps of pharaohs, crusaders and rulers.He visits the Indonesian Banda Islands, which were once the only place on Earth where nutmeg grew.He also visits Madagascar, the place of the largest vanilla cultivation.It also goes to India and the Middle East.He realizes that for hundreds of years, the East and the West have been linked by the spice trade.

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: The creators of the production invite viewers on a journey through the lush world of plants.It hides many surprising phenomena and hundreds of amazing heroes.Thanks to the lenses of specialized cameras, the mysterious life of nature's creations will be shown up close.Scientific research shows that nature is a perfect system of connecting vessels.In each of the five episodes, we will learn about a different group of plants and the secrets of their survival.The creators will talk about, among others:stories about seeds that can survive civilizations, trees that take care of each other, and creatures of nature that are as aggressive and spontaneous as animals.We will also learn about the relationships between people and animals with plants.It turns out that plants count, hunt, cheat, communicate, protect their relatives and manipulate animals for their own purposes.Contrary to appearances, when plants and animals interact with each other, it is usually the plant that sets the tone of the relationship.The series' narrator will be Sir David Attenborough, a popularizer of natural science Viewers will discover the world of aquatic plants.They create some of the most beautiful and important habitats on Earth.Life in water is not easy, which is why individual plant species have found innovative ways to survive.The color-changing algae that grows on the Rainbow River in Colombia sticks to rocks thanks to a natural version of superglue.In the Brazilian Pantanal, plants fight for light using air bags.Their goal is to stay afloat and reproduce quickly.The globe seaweed, which comes from Japan, uses the water currents of Lake Akan to move to an ideal place for development.During the flowering period, aquatic plants behave like terrestrial plants for a time, displaying flowers into the air on stiff stems.Only one flowering plant has reached the sea and forms underwater communities - seagrass.Its submerged savannahs not only support large numbers of animals, but also sequester carbon dioxide 35 times faster than tropical forests.Now under threat, they are crucial in the fight against climate change.

programme.desc: In her hometown, Detective Ember Manning (Jenna Coleman) begins to experience a series of terrifying events.The investigator tries to solve their mystery.He checks whether the death of a risk-taking journalist, a fire that broke out on a boat, and an illegal relationship with minors have anything in common.When he seeks the truth, he does not agree to compromise.This time, however, the truth may prove dangerous to her orderly life.He must look at his past differently, understand the complicated present, and see the real face of the city he considers home.

programme.title: Blue Lights 2
programme.desc: Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) are on duty in Belfast.They quickly discover that no training will prepare them for what they have to face - reality can be much more demanding and unpredictable.A year has passed since the dismantling of the McIntyre gang, but the vacuum left behind is immediately filled with new groups fighting for dominance.As tensions mount, the team is joined by Constable Shane Bradley (Frank Blake), whose intentions raise doubts among his colleagues.When a young loyalist begins to destabilize the fragile balance in the city, the police face the specter of a brutal confrontation.Their personal lives are equally turbulent.Tommy is considering going into intelligence more and more seriously, and Grace is struggling with missing her son and the feelings she begins to bond with one of the officers.

programme.title: Born to climb
programme.desc: Bobby, aka Lin Ziguan, is a passionate young climber in Wenzhou City, east China's Zhejiang Province. He first came across the sport when his parents took him to an indoor climbing facility at a local shopping mall for fun, and it was a case of love at first sight. To further fuel his passion, Bobby's father refurnished a room at home and turned it into a private rock-climbing gym. While many students find themselves \"climbing the walls\" with frustration on weeknights and grumbling at their homework, Bobby spends most of his free time clambering around the surfaces of his bedroom as he aspires to become a celebrated outdoor rock climber one day.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer \"star\" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill.\nKleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: \"Foodwise\" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. \nFrom the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. \nIn this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. \nDive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods.

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s \"Pinocchio Adventure\"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own \"Pinocchio Adventure\" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life.

programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as \"The First City along the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates.\nAlong the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip.

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous \"Crossing the Bridge\" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”\nThe program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China.\nIn this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi.\nFrom the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity.\nThis is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals.\nThe episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished.\nIn the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. With time, Corban became more than a religious festival. It developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar.\nCorban is as important as New Year. Kashgar locals load their tables with food on this day to reward themselves for a year of hard work. Corban is all about sharing. In the past, rich families would buy extra meat to share with their neighbors and friends. This tradition is still alive in Kashgar today, although it’s practiced not just by the rich, but pretty well everyone.

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's \"China Highly Recommended\" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. Take in the majesty of the Potala Palace, discover intangible cultural heritage skills such as Tibetan paper making and Tibetan incense, and experience the plateau's natural wonders in a whole new light.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called \"Manluanzhan\" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm?\n\nIn Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN as we reveal how a drop of crude oil transforms into our clothes, uncovering a complex and fascinating journey of the textile and garment manufacturing process. \nFollow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: Road absurdities 4
programme.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face. Kamil and Krzysiek will go to Tczew, where they will be stopped by a locked railway crossing.The presenters will also visit Sztum to see absurd road signs on the local bicycle path.In turn, when passing through Malbork, they will discover the "mayor's beret", i.e. a roundabout built on a straight road.Syrenka S201 will appear in Gdańsk, Ełk and Oława.Finally, a short visit to Warsaw: on the grounds of the National Stadium and at an unused bus stop built for about thirty thousand zlotys.

programme.title: Road absurdities 4
programme.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face. While tracking down road absurdities, the leaders will be in Bielawa and Oleśnica.In Wrocław they will be surprised by traffic lights that glow only orange, and in Syców they will be surprised by completely unnecessary road signs.In turn, in Tczew, Kamil and Krzysiek will cross a pedestrian crossing leading to a 25-centimeter-wide sidewalk.The crew of Syrenka S201 will also solve the mystery of the tonnage limitation in Łeba.Finally, there will be a ride along the Warsaw fire road and examination of the intersection at Sokolej Street.

One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. programme.title: The Lodger

The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer.

programme.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends

So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley

But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel.

programme.title: Milkiyat
programme.desc: Soha, a young woman raised by her grandfather after losing her parents, lives a simple yet strong life. She is happily married to Rafay, a loving and caring husband. However, her world falls apart when Rafay dies in a tragic accident. Zaviyar is a wealthy and arrogant man who has everything in life except true love. He was once deeply in love but after being betrayed, he no longer believes in relationships and keeps his distance from emotions. Fate brings Soha and Zaviyar together, but they are unaware of their true connection at first. Zaviyar is burdened by guilt from a mistake in his past, and in an attempt to ease it, he begins helping Soha and her family. Over time, this brings him closer to her, and he gradually falls in love. Will Zaviyar get his love? Why is Soha not convinced by Zaviyar’s love? Can Zaviyar escape the guilt that follows him every step? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Case No.9
programme.desc: Case No 9 is an inspiring story of Sehar, a courageous and ambitious young woman who challenges societal norms and becomes a beacon of resistance for others. Sehar, confident and driven, joins the company of Kamran, a domineering businessman feared by everyone for his egoistic and controlling nature. Unlike others, Sehar refuses to conform, letting her talent and integrity shine. Sehar’s defiance unsettles Kamran, who sets out to teach her a lesson. What follows is Sehar’s journey of redemption and resilience as she navigates the challenges thrown her way. Will Kamran succeed in teaching Sehar a lesson, or will she rise above his schemes? Can Sehar find the strength and support to overcome the odds, or will Kamran’s wealth and influence prove insurmountable? Geo and 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Behkaway
programme.desc: In a world where desires blur the lines between right and wrong, one man’s pursuit of happiness sets off a chain of irreversible consequences. Zubair, a middle-aged man hardened by ego and entitlement, rules over his household with an iron hand. His wife, Zeenat, bears the weight of his injustices in silence, enduring not only his coldness but the cruelty of his mother and sister. Despite her unwavering love and devotion, Zeenat receives nothing but pain in return. But everything begins to shift when Zubair encounters Sitara, a young, captivating woman whose charm ignites a dangerous spark within him. Driven by selfish desires, Zubair makes a decision that sets off a ripple effect far beyond his control. Will Zubair abandon Zeenat after meeting Sitara? Will his decision have consequences for his family? And will Sitara prove to be a blessing or a nightmare in disguise for him? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Pehli Barish
programme.desc: Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself. Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred. Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago. Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds? GEO & 7th Sky Entertainment presentation

programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Dil Awaiz
programme.desc: This is a story of a young girl named Dil Awaiz who despite living in her father’s house is treated as an orphan and is deprived of love and care. Dil Awaiz’s father, Shahab Uddin is an influential and wealthy businessman who keeps his distance from his firstborn, Dil Awaiz due to her mother’s past. Things take an unexpected turn when a handsome, young man Sikandar enters Dil Awaiz’s life and once again she is expected to compromise and sacrifice herself in order to save her family’s honour and respect. Despite living like an outsider all her life will Dil Awaiz be able to make yet another sacrifice? Even after all the atrocities, will Dil Awaiz be able to gain due respect in the house?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Bojh

Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. programme.title: Dil Awaiz
programme.desc: This is a story of a young girl named Dil Awaiz who despite living in her father’s house is treated as an orphan and is deprived of love and care. Despite living like an outsider all her life will Dil Awaiz be able to make yet another sacrifice? Even after all the atrocities, will Dil Awaiz be able to gain due respect in the house?

programme.title: Geo Pakistan
programme.desc: Geo Pakistan aims to deliver news from every genre with the main focus firmly resting on hard, political and national news. Taking inspiration from a newspaper, Geo Pakistan aspires to cover and deliver content of all sort, type and importance. Every thing under the sun, is NEWS! While a traditional news bulletin does not allow room for the anchors to engage with one another, Geo Pakistan’s anchors often banter on points of interest whilst highlighting the perspective or the concerns, of the masses. The news bulletin style show has been designed to maximize on the Geo News and JANG group's, strengths. From reporters to bureau chief to the OSR's, we will be engaging with experts & analysts to highlight varying angles to each news story. Huma Amir Shah Abdullah Sultan

programme.title: Ghulam Bashah Sundri
programme.desc: Set in a world where emotions run deep and power defines fate, Ghulam Bashah Sundri is a gripping drama of love, rivalry, and control. As relationships are tested and loyalties begin to fracture, desire turns into conflict and hearts become battlegrounds. At the center lies a compelling love triangle that draws each character into an intense emotional, social, and personal reckoning, where every choice carries consequences.

programme.title: Maa
programme.desc: Maa is an emotional family drama about love, loss, and identity. The story follows Raaha, a lively young girl raised by her grandfather, unaware of the painful truth about her birth. Abandoned by her mother Tara to protect her, and separated from her parents due to class differences and betrayal. Will Raaha uncover the truth about her past and find the love she was denied?

programme.title: Humnava
programme.desc: Humnava is more than just a drama it’s an emotional journey through love betrayal and resilience. It tells the story of a woman whose world is shaken when the one she trusted the most breaks her heart. But this is not just her story it reflects the pain of every person who’s ever been torn between loyalty and heartbreak. As relationships are tested and conspiracies unfold Humnava shows how real love doesn’t fade it fights it survives and it rises. Through shattered trust emotional trials and inner strength this drama is a reminder that in the end truth and sincerity always win.
