programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats, symbols of wild nature, today face the challenge of survival in a changing world.More and more often, their paths cross with people, leading to inevitable conflicts.On this journey, we learn about their unique adaptive skills: cheetahs use cars for hunting, jaguars dive near boats, and lions appear more and more often on the streets of Indian cities.This fresh look shows the cunning of predators, which are still among the most dangerous inhabitants of nature.

programme.title: Pompeii
programme.desc: In 79 A.D., Pompeii, a bustling port city, stands in the shadow of Mount Vesuvius. programme.desc: With innocent victims caught in the crossfire in Los Angeles' intensifying war on crime, both cop John Spartan (Sylvester Stallone) and violent thug Simon Phoenix (Wesley Snipes) are sentenced to a state of frozen incarceration known as "CryoPrison." When Spartan is finally thawed 36 years later, it's 2032, and Los Angeles is now a pacifist utopia called San Angeles. But with Phoenix again on the loose, Spartan must team up with future cop Lenina (Sandra Bullock) to apprehend the killer.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Wrongfully accused, Carter and John Artis were sentenced to 3 life terms in prison.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: "Couples Therapy" is a documentary series following couples as they seek the help of psychoanalyst Dr. Orna Guralnik with their troubled relationships; coming off their previous success with the award-winning documentary "Weiner", executive producers Josh Kriegman and Elyse Steinberg are collaborating on the unscripted series that will feature real couples from New York City and its surrounding areas; the show strives to present the participants and the therapy process with empathy and not sensationalism as viewers track the couples' progress with Dr. Guralnik through each episode.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers.

programme.title: Buy a castle
programme.desc: In Poland, in the early 1990s, it was possible to buy castles and palaces.However, many of these historic buildings were in very poor condition, requiring commitment, time and a lot of money.Journalist and traveler Joanna Lamparska and historian and art expert Michał Wójcik meet people whose passion is to renovate and restore neglected architectural pearls to their former glory.They travel to many places around the country, checking what efforts the new owners are making to breathe new life into historic buildings The first episode will present the story of a married couple who have been restoring the palace in Pieszyce for years.When the Hajduks took over the castle in October 2000, it was a huge ruin, with collapsed ceilings and destroyed staircases.Now, although the construction has not been completed yet, the place has regained its former splendor and splendor.The reconstruction of the palace is the largest undertaking of this type in Europe.The work has already cost over PLN 100 million.Thanks to enthusiasts such as Mr. Marian Hajduk, the palace is returning to its former glory and pleases the eyes of visitors with incredible attention to detail.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who have converted buildings previously used for service or industrial purposes into houses.Marcelina and Dawid looked for their place on earth for a long time.Finally, they decided to renovate the old mushroom farm that belonged to the family.Converting a commercial building into a residential building presented many challenges.Krzysztof decided to adapt the former printing plant to his needs.He now lives in a surprising interior, from the outside resembling a cube glued to a block of flats in Wrocław.Mateusz and his relatives accidentally came across a mill during a trip to Siedlce.The view from the third floor of the building overlooking the river helped them decide to purchase this unusual building.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska this time visits people whose households should be called crazy.Agnieszka is the owner of Kozi Stok, a farm located near Wieliczka, where she breeds Carpathian goats.Out of love for acrobatics and her son, the woman built a place suspended in the treetops.Jacek and his family lived in a 227-year-old wooden windmill standing in a landscape park.The renovation of this historic building became the man's true passion.Malwina inherited her love for water from her father, a sailor.The man managed to fulfill his dream of building a house on the water.It stands in Warsaw's Czerniakowski Port.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who have turned ordinary allotment gardens into real gems.Alina built an arched house on her piece of land, which measures less than 14 square meters.The building is surrounded by a vegetable garden, flowerbeds and a small orchard.Aneta and her husband's plot, located near Olsztyn, is surrounded by greenery.The couple made many of its elements themselves.After Patrycja bought her own piece of land, her father and the woman's partner built a house there together.In this way, they fulfilled Patrycja's dream of having morning coffee on her own terrace.

programme.title: Manhunt with Joel Lambert
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL, Joel Lambert, faces an elite reconnaissance unit of the American army.Within two days, he must cover a specific route so as not to get caught.During this unusual mission, he can use the items he has in his backpack and what he finds along the way.Thanks to modern filming techniques, viewers follow the manhunt, both from the point of view of the hunted and the commandos tracking him.The program was shot in the United States, Poland, South Africa, the Philippines, Panama and South Korea.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna goes to Romania, where she visits Iana Matei, founder of the Reaching Out organization, which helps victims of human trafficking.This country is considered the European center of slavery.Iana Matei has been fighting traffickers for 18 years.He does everything he can to save the children they abuse.By stealing victims from the hands of criminals, he tries to give them back their childhood and give them a home.Her pupils call her "Mom".Iana currently cares for 15 girls.The youngest of them was sold when she was 9 years old, while another was exchanged for 4 cigarettes.During Iana's 18 years of work, she saved over 500 girls.Her biggest dream is to stop human trafficking.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna goes to Saint Petersburg, where she will meet Larisa Renar, who runs the Academy of Private Life.Women can find answers to all their questions about women's and men's issues there.Over 150,000 students have already completed courses conducted by Larisa - not only from Russia, but also from China, England, the United Arab Emirates, Bulgaria and Turkey.The heroine of the episode completed her MBA;is a psychologist, motivational trainer, and author of eight guides for women.For Russian women, whose salary is 1/3 less than men's, marriage has not only a romantic aspect, but also a business one.Hence the popularity of Larissa Academy.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska will visit Florida, where Maja Kazawiedź lives - a woman who escaped from a war-torn country - and Winter the dolphin.At Clearwater Marine Aquarium, the fates of man and animal intertwine.The heroine of the episode comes from Bosnia.She was fifteen years old when armed conflict broke out in the former Yugoslavia in 1992.Winter, in turn, as a 2-month-old baby, became entangled in the nets.Both of them came close to death, but survived thanks to their extraordinary determination and exceptional strength of character.Today they support others.Their story helped Martyna Wojciechowska in her own struggles with adversity.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments Part 1 The Laws of God
programme.desc: A grand retelling of the epic story of Moses. Escaping death, a Hebrew infant is raised in a royal household to become a prince. Upon discovery of his true heritage, Moses embarks on a personal quest to reclaim his destiny as the leader and liberator of the Hebrew people.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments Part 2 The Laws of Man
programme.desc: After narrowly avoiding death, a Hebrew baby is adopted into a royal family and grows up to be a prince. Once he learns the truth about his origins, Moses begins his journey to fulfill his destiny as the leader who will free the Hebrew slaves in Egypt.

programme.title: #No Joke
programme.desc: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian’s plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn’t go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: After Lily rejects her boyfriend's marriage proposal, she returns home to Hawaii where she must help out with her mother's wedding planning business.

programme.title: A Time to Dance
programme.desc: A Time to Dance follows the bittersweet story of longtime couple John and Abby, whose separation is postponed when they find out their daughter is getting married. Determined not to spoil their daughter's big moment, they secretly put their plans on hold only to have the wedding planning process draw them back together.

programme.title: Triple Cross
programme.desc: During WW2, convicted bank robber Eddie Chapman becomes a triple agent working for both the British and the Germans.

programme.title: Sommersby

programme.title: Twist Of Fate
programme.desc: Grieving over the untimely loss of his family and in a dissociative state, an aimlessly-wandering Jewish man is rescued by another family who help him find his way back to happiness again.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Jen Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, becomes entangled in the web of a narcissist patient whose path to perfection threatens to destroy Jen and her family.

programme.title: Bonds will be Broken
programme.desc: When her sister Nina is seduced by a mysterious self-improvement cult, Anna decides to go undercover at the cult's annual retreat to save her sister from the sinister cult leader.
